⇒ such a row reaches `inferWidget` **and all five detectors** carrying a node with **no `type`, no `properties`, no `enum`**. ⭐ **The author therefore gets the raw-JSON fallback, instead of an editor derived from the shape the schema does in fact declare** — the shape is right there in `$defs` and nothing looks at it.

## Class (c), by the definition

An AI (or a person) authors metadata through this form. The form is handed a schema that **does** declare the shape, does ⛔ not follow the one indirection that would reveal it, and drops the author into free-text JSON — where nothing validates the keys they invent until the runtime refuses them. ⇒ 「AI 写元数据会被运行时拒收或静默丢弃的陷阱」, arrived at through an editor that had the answer and did not look.
